question: Which of the following is the operation started by the Government of India in the year 2018-19 to ensure the availability of tomato, onion and potatoes round the year without price volatility?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Operation Greens**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Operation Greens** was launched by the Government of India in **2018-19** to ensure the availability of **tomatoes, onions, and potatoes (TOP)** throughout the year and to prevent price volatility. The main goals of this initiative are:
 
• **Price Stabilization**: To prevent excessive price fluctuations in these essential commodities by creating a buffer stock, promoting better supply chain management, and encouraging cold storage facilities.
